Filed by the rider; SGD 5.00 no-show/cancellation fee on EV-FARE-06051, charged to the rider. On-demand trip (EV-TRIP-06051 scheduled_at null). EV-TRIP-06051 marks arrival at 06:59:05; EV-GPS-06051 fixes sit 8 m from the pickup pin, inside the STANDARD radius of 50 m, with accuracy within 25 m, so the arrival is corroborated (no_show.json arrival_test). Driver cancelled at 07:05:40, 6 min 35 s after arrival: the 300 s free wait had run (POL-NS-21, v2.1 2.1). EV-CHAT-06051 shows 2 driver chat message(s) before cancellation (first at 06:59:30). Driver call(s) before cancellation: EV-TRIP-06051 in_app_calls placed_by DRIVER at 07:01:50; an unanswered call still counts as placed. Arrival corroborated, free wait run, chat message and call both before cancellation: the fee stands and goes to the driver, so the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of the fee charged (POL-NS-22, v2.1 2.2). The AI ruling on a no-show is final (POL-NS-26, v2.1 6.2); confidence cap 1.0. Governing: POL-NS-22 (v2.1 2.2); POL-NS-21 (v2.1 2.1); POL-NS-23 (v2.1 2.3); POL-NS-26 (v2.1 6.2 and 6.3).
